trigger_condition: A descendant replay is discovered before the parent transcript whose responses and tools it inherits
guard_snippet: Visit owners in ancestry order before assigning response ownership and building toolOwners.
potential_consequence: Parent usage moves to descendants; replayed tools acquire conflicting owners and break otherwise valid ancestry.

trigger_condition: Two subagent transcripts claim the same tool-use ID
potential_consequence: The first claimant receives arbitrary exact attribution while the duplicate conflict remains hidden.

trigger_condition: A nested agent completion notification exists only in its parent subagent transcript
potential_consequence: Completed or failed nested work remains incomplete and loses its authoritative completion duration.

trigger_condition: An async result supplies agentId, but its transcript is missing and completion supplies taskId only
potential_consequence: Exact completion evidence is discarded, leaving finished work unknown whenever its transcript is unavailable.

trigger_condition: A synchronous Agent, Task, or Skill result carries is_error or isError
potential_consequence: Failed invocations appear completed and increase exported success counts instead of failure counts.

trigger_condition: Subagent transcripts replay an existing slash-command message
potential_consequence: Inherited commands become additional nested invocations, inflating command totals and timeline rows.

trigger_condition: Recognized native invocations have missing or invalid timestamps
potential_consequence: The incomplete timeline replaces preserved invocation summaries and silently erases untimed calls.

trigger_condition: Combined family timestamps exceed the JavaScript argument limit although each individual transcript stays below it
guard_snippet: for (const timestamp of timestamps) { start = Math.min(start, timestamp); end = Math.max(end, timestamp); }
potential_consequence: Spreading family timestamps throws RangeError and aborts native session loading.

trigger_condition: Post-/clear session timing previously excluded the sentinel and earlier metadata
guard_snippet: Compute root family bounds from stripClear(parsed.messages), then merge descendant bounds.
potential_consequence: Idle time before the first post-clear prompt now inflates session duration and shifts period bounds.

trigger_condition: A session has unlinked agents but no timeline dispatch buttons
potential_consequence: The focus trap wraps before the disclosure, preventing keyboard access to unlinked agent IDs.
